scheme_name: Scheme for assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Seed Support
other_conditions: Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible
The scheme is sector‑agnostic and open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc.
Startups already receiving benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹30,00,000 for prototype development, market research, testing, trials, and marketing/publicity for attending events.
